description: This file defines the IncludeEmployee class, which extends FilterField and is part of the reporting filter system in the OrangeHRM project. It adds specific query restrictions for including or excluding employees based on termination records.

classes.name: IncludeEmployee
classes.description: A class extending FilterField to handle filtering logic related to employee inclusion/exclusion based on termination records.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to filter employees who are either terminated or not, based on the operator.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias 'employee' used in the query for filtering purposes.
